name: apex-internet-banking-microservices
description: Production-grade Internet Banking Microservices Architecture with API Gateway, Event Bus, Saga Orchestration, and Real-Time Dashboard

scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "@(8080,8081,8082,8083,8084,8085,8086) | ForEach-Object { $p = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Output 'All microservices stopped.'"

author: Apex Banking Engineering
